description: Reads a value as a sixteen-bit binary number and puts each bit out as a gate on its own channel of a polyphonic cable, with a control that rotates which bit each channel takes

params.text: Sets the number that is converted to binary, over 0 to 9.9999 scaled so the full travel covers the sixteen bits; it starts at 0, which leaves every gate low
Rotates which bit each of the sixteen gate channels reads; the -10 to 10 travel covers one whole turn in each direction, but negative settings do not wrap

inputs.text: Replaces the value knob with this voltage, 0V to 10V covering the sixteen bits, so the knob does nothing while a cable is patched here
Replaces the shift knob with this voltage, 1.6 bits of rotation per volt, so the knob does nothing while a cable is patched here

outputs.text: Sixteen channels of gate, 10V where that bit of the value is set and 0V where it is not

notes: The sixteen lamps carry the same sixteen gates the polyphonic output does, one lamp per channel.
The module comes up with its value at 0, so every gate is low and the output is silent until the value is turned up or a cable is patched into it.

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the value knob.
inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the shift knob.
